simple.meaning: הַצָּלָה (hatstsâlâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “rescue.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Esther 4:14. The surrounding context includes family, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to הַצָּלָה (H2020) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
